\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Cauchy--Schwarz bound for the Ricci tensor] For every unit vector $X$, \[ |\Ric (X,\cdot )|^2\leq R\Ric (X,X). \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Diagonalize the nonnegative Ricci tensor with eigenvalues $\lambda _i$. Then the two sides are $\sum _i(X^i)^2\lambda _i^2$ and $(\sum _i\lambda _i)\sum _i(X^i)^2\lambda _i$, respectively.

□

Corollary
[Summary: non-compact soliton splitting]
